queries.query: WITH "monthlyflightcounts" AS (SELECT "flights"."origin" AS "origin", MONTH("flights"."flightdate") AS "month", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" GROUP BY "flights"."origin", MONTH("flights"."flightdate") ORDER BY "month" DESC, "totalflights" DESC), "topairportsbymonth" AS (SELECT "monthlyflightcounts"."month" AS "month", "monthlyflightcounts"."origin" AS "origin", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "monthlyflightcounts"."month" ORDER BY "monthlyflightcounts"."totalflights" DESC) AS "airportrank" FROM "monthlyflightcounts" AS "monthlyflightcounts") SELECT "f"."ff"."month" AS "month", "t"."origin" AS "origin", CASE WHEN "f"."deptimeblk" IN ('0600-0659', '0700-0759', '0800-0859', '1600-1659', '1700-1759', '1800-1859') THEN 'Peak' ELSE 'Off-Peak' END AS "timeofday", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", ROUND(AVG("f"."taxiout"), 2) AS "avgtaxiout", ROUND(AVG("f"."depdelay"), 2) AS "avgdepdelay", ROUND(AVG("f"."arrdelay"), 2) AS "avgarrdelay", ROUND(CORR("f"."taxiout", "f"."depdelay"), 2) AS "taxiout_depdelay_correlation", ROUND(CORR("f"."taxiout", "f"."arrdelay"), 2) AS "taxiout_arrdelay_correlation", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "delayedflights", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) AS "percentdelayed" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" JOIN "topairportsbymonth" AS "t" ON "f"."origin" = "t"."origin" AND "t"."airportrank" <= 10 AND "t"."month" = MONTH("f"."flightdate") WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE GROUP BY "f"."ff"."month", "t"."origin", CASE WHEN "f"."deptimeblk" IN ('0600-0659', '0700-0759', '0800-0859', '1600-1659', '1700-1759', '1800-1859') THEN 'Peak' ELSE 'Off-Peak' END ORDER BY "month" DESC, "origin" NULLS LAST, "timeofday" NULLS LAST

WITH "airportdiscrepancy" AS (SELECT "flights"."origin" AS "airport", "flights"."origincityname" AS "airportcity", "flights"."originstate" AS "airportstate", 'Origin' AS "airportrole", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", AVG("flights"."actualelapsedtime" - "flights"."crselapsedtime") AS "avgdiscrepancy", AVG("flights"."depdelay") AS "avgdepdelay", AVG("flights"."depdelayminutes") AS "avgdepdelayminutes", AVG("flights"."taxiout") AS "avgtaxiout", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "percentdelayeddepartures", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."diverted" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "percentdiverted", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."cancelled" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "percentcancelled" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE "flights"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "flights"."crselapsedtime" > 0 AND NOT "flights"."actualelapsedtime" IS NULL AND NOT "flights"."crselapsedtime" IS NULL GROUP BY "flights"."origin", "flights"."origincityname", "flights"."originstate" UNION ALL SELECT "flights"."dest" AS "airport", "flights"."destcityname" AS "airportcity", "flights"."deststate" AS "airportstate", 'Destination' AS "airportrole", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", AVG("flights"."actualelapsedtime" - "flights"."crselapsedtime") AS "avgdiscrepancy", AVG("flights"."arrdelay") AS "avgdepdelay", AVG("flights"."arrdelayminutes") AS "avgdepdelayminutes", AVG("flights"."taxiin") AS "avgtaxiout", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."arrdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "percentdelayeddepartures", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."diverted" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "percentdiverted", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."cancelled" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "percentcancelled" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE "flights"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "flights"."crselapsedtime" > 0 AND NOT "flights"."actualelapsedtime" IS NULL AND NOT "flights"."crselapsedtime" IS NULL GROUP BY "flights"."dest", "flights"."destcityname", "flights"."deststate"), "rankedairports" AS (SELECT "airportdiscrepancy"."airport" AS "airport", "airportdiscrepancy"."airportcity" AS "airportcity", "airportdiscrepancy"."airportstate" AS "airportstate", "airportdiscrepancy"."airportrole" AS "airportrole", "airportdiscrepancy"."totalflights" AS "totalflights", "airportdiscrepancy"."avgdiscrepancy" AS "avgdiscrepancy", "airportdiscrepancy"."avgdepdelay" AS "avgdepdelay", "airportdiscrepancy"."avgdepdelayminutes" AS "avgdepdelayminutes", "airportdiscrepancy"."avgtaxiout" AS "avgtaxiout", "airportdiscrepancy"."percentdelayeddepartures" AS "percentdelayeddepartures", "airportdiscrepancy"."percentdiverted" AS "percentdiverted", "airportdiscrepancy"."percentcancelled" AS "percentcancelled", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "airportdiscrepancy"."avgdiscrepancy" DESC) AS "discrepancyrank" FROM "airportdiscrepancy" AS "airportdiscrepancy" WHERE "airportdiscrepancy"."totalflights" > 1000) SELECT "rankedairports"."airport" AS "airport", "rankedairports"."airportcity" AS "airportcity", "rankedairports"."airportstate" AS "airportstate", "rankedairports"."airportrole" AS "airportrole", "rankedairports"."totalflights" AS "totalflights", ROUND("rankedairports"."avgdiscrepancy", 2) AS "avgdiscrepancyminutes", ROUND("rankedairports"."avgdepdelay", 2) AS "avgdelayminutes", ROUND("rankedairports"."avgdepdelayminutes", 2) AS "avgdelayminutesnonnegative", ROUND("rankedairports"."avgtaxiout", 2) AS "avgtaxitimeminutes", ROUND("rankedairports"."percentdelayeddepartures" * 100, 2) AS "percentdelayedflights", ROUND("rankedairports"."percentdiverted" * 100, 2) AS "percentdivertedflights", ROUND("rankedairports"."percentcancelled" * 100, 2) AS "percentcancelledflights", "rankedairports"."discrepancyrank" AS "discrepancyrank" FROM "rankedairports" AS "rankedairports" WHERE "rankedairports"."discrepancyrank" <= 20 ORDER BY "discrepancyrank" NULLS LAST

SELECT "f"."operating_airline" AS "airline", "f"."dayofweek" AS "dayofweek", COUNT("f"."operating_airline") AS "totalflights", ROUND(AVG("f"."depdelayminutes"), 2) AS "avgdeparturedelayminutes", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "ontimeflights", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT("f"."operating_airline")), 2) AS "ontimeperformancepercent" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "f"."depdelayminutes" IS NULL GROUP BY "f"."operating_airline", "f"."dayofweek" ORDER BY "ontimeperformancepercent" DESC, "avgdeparturedelayminutes" NULLS LAST

WITH "majorairports" AS (SELECT "flights"."origin" AS "airport", "flights"."origincityname" AS "airportcity", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" GROUP BY "flights"."origin", "flights"."origincityname" ORDER BY "totalflights" DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT "f"."origin" AS "airport", "m"."airportcity" AS "airportcity", "f"."deptimeblk" AS "deptimeblk", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", ROUND(AVG("f"."taxiout"), 2) AS "avgtaxioutminutes", ROUND(AVG("f"."depdelayminutes"), 2) AS "avgdeparturedelayminutes", ROUND(CORR("f"."taxiout", "f"."depdelayminutes"), 3) AS "taxiout_depdelay_correlation", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "delayedflights", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) AS "percentdelayed15plus", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."taxiout" <= 10 THEN "f"."depdelayminutes" END), 2) AS "avgdelay_taxiout_0_10", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."taxiout" <= 20 AND "f"."taxiout" > 10 THEN "f"."depdelayminutes" END), 2) AS "avgdelay_taxiout_11_20", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."taxiout" > 20 THEN "f"."depdelayminutes" END), 2) AS "avgdelay_taxiout_20plus" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" JOIN "majorairports" AS "m" ON "f"."origin" = "m"."airport" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."deptimeblk" IN ('0600-0659', '0700-0759', '0800-0859', '1600-1659', '1700-1759', '1800-1859') AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "f"."depdelayminutes" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."taxiout" IS NULL GROUP BY "f"."origin", "m"."airportcity", "f"."deptimeblk" ORDER BY "airport" NULLS LAST, "deptimeblk" NULLS LAST

SELECT "f"."origin" AS "airport", "f"."origin_city_name" AS "airport_city", "f"."origin_state" AS "airport_state", COUNT("f"."flight_id") AS "total_flights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."dep_del15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "delayed_flights", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."dep_del15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT("f"."flight_id")), 2) AS "percent_delayed_flights", ROUND(AVG("f"."dep_delay"), 2) AS "avg_departure_delay_minutes", ROUND(AVG("f"."taxi_out"), 2) AS "avg_taxi_out_minutes" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "f"."dep_del15" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."dep_delay" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."taxi_out" IS NULL GROUP BY "f"."origin", "f"."origin_city_name", "f"."origin_state" HAVING COUNT("f"."flight_id") > 1000 ORDER BY "percent_delayed_flights" DESC, "avg_departure_delay_minutes" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT "f"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", ROUND(CORR("f"."depdelayminutes", "f"."arrdelayminutes"), 3) AS "delaycorrelation", ROUND(AVG("f"."depdelayminutes"), 2) AS "avgdeparturedelayminutes", ROUND(AVG("f"."arrdelayminutes"), 2) AS "avgarrivaldelayminutes", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentdelayeddepartures", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."arrdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentdelayedarrivals" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "f"."arrdelayminutes" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."depdelayminutes" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."distancegroup" IS NULL GROUP BY "f"."distancegroup" ORDER BY "distancegroup" NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN "f"."distance" < 500 THEN 'Short-Haul (<500 miles)' WHEN "f"."distance" > 1500 THEN 'Long-Haul (>1500 miles)' END AS "flightcategory", "f"."departuredelaygroups" AS "departuredelaygroups", COUNT(*) AS "flightcount", ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN "f"."distance" < 500 THEN 'Short-Haul (<500 miles)' WHEN "f"."distance" > 1500 THEN 'Long-Haul (>1500 miles)' END), 2) AS "percentageofcategory", ROUND(AVG("f"."depdelayminutes"), 2) AS "avgdelayminutes", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentdelayed15plus" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND ("f"."distance" < 500 OR "f"."distance" > 1500) AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "f"."departuredelaygroups" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."distance" IS NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN "f"."distance" < 500 THEN 'Short-Haul (<500 miles)' WHEN "f"."distance" > 1500 THEN 'Long-Haul (>1500 miles)' END, "f"."departuredelaygroups" ORDER BY "flightcategory" NULLS LAST, "departuredelaygroups" NULLS LAST

WITH "distancegroupaverages" AS (SELECT "flights"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."arrdel15" = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "avgdelayrate" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE "flights"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "flights"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "flights"."arrdel15" IS NULL GROUP BY "flights"."distancegroup"), "airportdelayrates" AS (SELECT "flights"."dest" AS "destinationairport", "flights"."destcityname" AS "destinationcity", "flights"."deststate" AS "destinationstate", "flights"."arrtimeblk" AS "arrivaltimeblock", "flights"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."arrdel15" = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "delayrate" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE "flights"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "flights"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "flights"."arrdel15" IS NULL GROUP BY "flights"."dest", "flights"."destcityname", "flights"."deststate", "flights"."arrtimeblk", "flights"."distancegroup" HAVING COUNT(*) > 50) SELECT "adr"."destinationairport" AS "destinationairport", "adr"."destinationcity" AS "destinationcity", "adr"."destinationstate" AS "destinationstate", "adr"."arrivaltimeblock" AS "arrivaltimeblock", "adr"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", "adr"."totalflights" AS "totalflights", ROUND("adr"."delayrate" * 100, 2) AS "arrivaldelayratepercent", ROUND("dga"."avgdelayrate" * 100, 2) AS "avgdistancegroupdelayratepercent", ROUND(("adr"."delayrate" - "dga"."avgdelayrate") * 100, 2) AS "delayratedifferencefromaverage", ROUND(AVG("f"."arrdelayminutes") FILTER(WHERE "f"."arrdel15" = 1), 2) AS "avgdelaydurationminutes" FROM "airportdelayrates" AS "adr" JOIN "distancegroupaverages" AS "dga" ON "adr"."distancegroup" = "dga"."distancegroup" LEFT JOIN "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" ON "adr"."arrivaltimeblock" = "f"."arrtimeblk" AND "adr"."destinationairport" = "f"."dest" AND "adr"."distancegroup" = "f"."distancegroup" AND "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "f"."arrdel15" IS NULL GROUP BY "adr"."destinationairport", "adr"."destinationcity", "adr"."destinationstate", "adr"."arrivaltimeblock", "adr"."distancegroup", "adr"."totalflights", "adr"."delayrate", "dga"."avgdelayrate" ORDER BY "destinationairport" NULLS LAST, "distancegroup" NULLS LAST, "arrivaltimeblock" NULLS LAST

WITH "distancegroupaverages" AS (SELECT "flights"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."arrdelayminutes" >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "avgdelayrate" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE "flights"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "flights"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "flights"."arrdelayminutes" IS NULL GROUP BY "flights"."distancegroup"), "airportdelayrates" AS (SELECT "flights"."dest" AS "destinationairport", "flights"."destcityname" AS "destcityname", "flights"."deststate" AS "deststate", "flights"."arrtimeblk" AS "arrtimeblk", "flights"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."arrdelayminutes" >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "delayrate", AVG("flights"."arrdelayminutes") AS "avgarrdelayminutes" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE "flights"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "flights"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "flights"."arrdelayminutes" IS NULL GROUP BY "flights"."dest", "flights"."destcityname", "flights"."deststate", "flights"."arrtimeblk", "flights"."distancegroup" HAVING COUNT(*) > 50) SELECT "adr"."destinationairport" AS "destinationairport", "adr"."destcityname" AS "destinationcity", "adr"."deststate" AS "destinationstate", "adr"."arrtimeblk" AS "arrtimeblk", "adr"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", "adr"."totalflights" AS "totalflights", ROUND("adr"."delayrate" * 100, 2) AS "arrivaldelayratepercent", ROUND("dga"."avgdelayrate" * 100, 2) AS "avgdistancegroupdelayratepercent", ROUND(("adr"."delayrate" - "dga"."avgdelayrate") * 100, 2) AS "delayratedifferencefromaverage", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "adr"."avgarrdelayminutes" >= 15 THEN "adr"."avgarrdelayminutes" END), 2) AS "avgdelaydurationminutes" FROM "airportdelayrates" AS "adr" JOIN "distancegroupaverages" AS "dga" ON "adr"."distancegroup" = "dga"."distancegroup" GROUP BY "adr"."destinationairport", "adr"."destcityname", "adr"."deststate", "adr"."arrtimeblk", "adr"."distancegroup", "adr"."totalflights", "adr"."delayrate", "dga"."avgdelayrate" ORDER BY "destinationairport" NULLS LAST, "distancegroup" NULLS LAST, "arrtimeblk" NULLS LAST

SELECT "f"."origin_city_name" || ' → ' || "f"."dest_city_name" AS "city_pair", "f"."origin_city_name" AS "origin_city_name", "f"."dest_city_name" AS "dest_city_name", COUNT("f"."flight_id") AS "total_flights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "cancelled_flights", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT("f"."flight_id"), 0), 2) AS "cancellation_rate", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."month" IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "winter_flights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE AND "f"."month" IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "winter_cancelled", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE AND "f"."month" IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."month" IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "winter_cancellation_rate", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."month" IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "spring_flights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE AND "f"."month" IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "spring_cancelled", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE AND "f"."month" IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."month" IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "spring_cancellation_rate", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."month" IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "summer_flights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE AND "f"."month" IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "summer_cancelled", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE AND "f"."month" IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."month" IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "summer_cancellation_rate", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."month" IN (9, 10, 11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "fall_flights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE AND "f"."month" IN (9, 10, 11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "fall_cancelled", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" = TRUE AND "f"."month" IN (9, 10, 11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."month" IN (9, 10, 11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "fall_cancellation_rate" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" GROUP BY "f"."origin_city_name", "f"."dest_city_name" HAVING COUNT("f"."flight_id") > 100 ORDER BY "cancellation_rate" DESC LIMIT 50

WITH "routeperformance" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "flightfrequency", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."depdel15" = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "ontimedeparturerate", AVG(CASE WHEN "flights"."arrdel15" = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "ontimearrivalrate" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE NOT "flights"."cancelled" AND NOT "flights"."diverted" GROUP BY "flights"."origin", "flights"."dest" HAVING COUNT(*) > 100) SELECT CORR("routeperformance"."flightfrequency", "routeperformance"."ontimedeparturerate") AS "frequency_departurecorrelation", CORR("routeperformance"."flightfrequency", "routeperformance"."ontimearrivalrate") AS "frequency_arrivalcorrelation", COUNT(*) AS "totalroutesanalyzed", MIN("routeperformance"."flightfrequency") AS "minroutefrequency", MAX("routeperformance"."flightfrequency") AS "maxroutefrequency", AVG("routeperformance"."flightfrequency") AS "avgroutefrequency" FROM "routeperformance" AS "routeperformance"

SELECT "f"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", ROUND(AVG("f"."distance"), 2) AS "avgdistancemiles", ROUND(AVG("f"."airtime"), 2) AS "avgairtimeminutes", ROUND(AVG("f"."airtime" / NULLIF("f"."distance", 0)), 4) AS "avgminutespermile", ROUND(AVG("f"."crselapsedtime" / NULLIF("f"."distance", 0)), 4) AS "avgscheduledminutespermile", ROUND((AVG("f"."airtime" / NULLIF("f"."distance", 0)) - MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."distancegroup" = 1 THEN "f"."airtime" / NULLIF("f"."distance", 0) END)) * 100.0 / MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."distancegroup" = 1 THEN "f"."airtime" / NULLIF("f"."distance", 0) END), 2) AS "efficiencydeviationfromshortest", ROUND(AVG("f"."crselapsedtime" - "f"."airtime"), 2) AS "avgbuffertime", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."airtime" > "f"."crselapsedtime" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentflightsexceedingscheduledairtime" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE "f"."distance" > 0 AND NOT "f"."airtime" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."cancelled" AND NOT "f"."crselapsedtime" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."diverted" GROUP BY "f"."distancegroup" ORDER BY "distancegroup" NULLS LAST

SELECT "f"."distance_group" AS "distance_group", COUNT(*) AS "total_flights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "cancelled_flights", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."cancelled" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "cancellation_rate_percent", ROUND(AVG("f"."distance"), 2) AS "avg_distance_miles", ROUND(AVG("f"."month"), 2) AS "avg_month", ROUND(AVG("f"."day_of_week"), 2) AS "avg_day_of_week" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" GROUP BY "f"."distance_group" HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY "cancellation_rate_percent" DESC

WITH "airlinehubflights" AS (SELECT "flights"."operating_airline" AS "operating_airline", "flights"."origin" AS "hubairport", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "flights"."operating_airline" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "hubrank" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE NOT "flights"."cancelled" AND NOT "flights"."diverted" GROUP BY "flights"."operating_airline", "flights"."origin" HAVING COUNT(*) > 100), "airlinetaxiefficiency" AS (SELECT "f"."operating_airline" AS "operating_airline", "airlinehubflights"."hubairport" AS "hubairport", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", ROUND(AVG("f"."taxiout"), 2) AS "avgtaxiout", ROUND(STDDEV("f"."taxiout"), 2) AS "taxioutstddev", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 0 THEN "f"."taxiout" END), 2) AS "avgtaxioutontime", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN "f"."taxiout" END), 2) AS "avgtaxioutdelayed", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "ontimedeparturerate" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" JOIN "airlinehubflights" AS "airlinehubflights" ON "airlinehubflights"."hubairport" = "f"."origin" AND "airlinehubflights"."hubrank" = 1 AND "airlinehubflights"."operating_airline" = "f"."operating_airline" WHERE "f"."taxiout" > 0 AND NOT "f"."cancelled" AND NOT "f"."diverted" AND NOT "f"."taxiout" IS NULL GROUP BY "f"."operating_airline", "airlinehubflights"."hubairport" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) SELECT "airlinetaxiefficiency"."operating_airline" AS "operating_airline", "airlinetaxiefficiency"."hubairport" AS "hubairport", "airlinetaxiefficiency"."totalflights" AS "totalflights", "airlinetaxiefficiency"."avgtaxiout" AS "avgtaxiout", "airlinetaxiefficiency"."taxioutstddev" AS "taxioutstddev", "airlinetaxiefficiency"."avgtaxioutontime" AS "avgtaxioutontime", "airlinetaxiefficiency"."avgtaxioutdelayed" AS "avgtaxioutdelayed", "airlinetaxiefficiency"."ontimedeparturerate" AS "ontimedeparturerate", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "airlinetaxiefficiency"."avgtaxiout" NULLS LAST) AS "taxiefficiencyrank" FROM "airlinetaxiefficiency" AS "airlinetaxiefficiency" ORDER BY "taxiefficiencyrank" NULLS LAST

SELECT "f"."operating_airline" AS "operating_airline", CASE WHEN NOT "f"."operated_or_branded_code_share_partners" IS NULL AND "f"."operated_or_branded_code_share_partners" <> '' AND "f"."operated_or_branded_code_share_partners" <> 'NA' THEN 'Code-Share Operation' ELSE 'Regular Operation' END AS "operationtype", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS "departuredelayrate", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."arrdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS "arrivaldelayrate", ROUND(AVG("f"."depdelayminutes"), 2) AS "avgdeparturedelayminutes", ROUND(AVG("f"."arrdelayminutes"), 2) AS "avgarrivaldelayminutes", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS "ontimedeparturerate", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."arrdel15" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS "ontimearrivalrate" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "f"."arrdel15" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."depdel15" IS NULL GROUP BY "f"."operating_airline", CASE WHEN NOT "f"."operated_or_branded_code_share_partners" IS NULL AND "f"."operated_or_branded_code_share_partners" <> '' AND "f"."operated_or_branded_code_share_partners" <> 'NA' THEN 'Code-Share Operation' ELSE 'Regular Operation' END HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY "operating_airline" NULLS LAST, "operationtype" NULLS LAST

SELECT "f"."operating_airline" AS "operating_airline", CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9][A-Z]{4}$') THEN 'N + 1 digit + 4 letters' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{3}$') THEN 'N + 2 digits + 3 letters' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9][A-Z]{3}$') THEN 'N + 1 digit + 3 letters' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]{3}[A-Z]{2}$') THEN 'N + 3 digits + 2 letters' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{2}$') THEN 'N + 2 digits + 2 letters' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]{4}[A-Z]$') THEN 'N + 4 digits + "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE ("f"."cancelled" = FALSE OR "f"."cancelled" IS NULL) AND ("f"."diverted" = FALSE OR "f"."diverted" IS NULL) AND NOT "f"."depdel15" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."operating_airline" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."tail_number" IS NULL GROUP BY "f"."operating_airline", CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9][A-Z]{4}$') THEN 'N + 1 digit + 4 letters' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{3}$') THEN 'N + 2 digits + 3 letters' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9][A-Z]{3}$') THEN 'N + 1 digit + 3 letters' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]{4}[A-Z]$') THEN 'N + 4 digits + 1 letter' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]{3}[A-Z]$') THEN 'N + 3 digits + 1 letter' WHEN digits' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]{2}$') THEN 'N + 2 digits' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE("f"."tail_number", '^N[0-9]$') THEN 'N + 1 digit' ELSE 'Other' END HAVING COUNT("f"."tail_number") > 50 ORDER BY "operating_airline" NULLS LAST, "delaypercentage" DESC

SELECT "f"."operating_airline" AS "operating_airline", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "totaldelayeddepartures", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."arrdel15" = 0 AND "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "recoveredflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."arrdel15" = 1 AND "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "unrecoveredflights", ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."arrdel15" = 0 AND "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "recoveryratepercent", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN "f"."depdelayminutes" END), 2) AS "avgdeparturedelayfordelayedflights", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."arrdel15" = 0 AND "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN "f"."depdelayminutes" END), 2) AS "avgdeparturedelayforrecoveredflights", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "f"."arrdel15" = 1 AND "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN ("f"."arrdelayminutes" - "f"."depdelayminutes") END), 2) AS "avgdelayincreaseduringflight" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE AND NOT "f"."arrdel15" IS NULL AND NOT "f"."depdel15" IS NULL GROUP BY "f"."operating_airline" HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 100 ORDER BY "recoveryratepercent" DESC

SELECT "f"."flightdate" AS "flightdate", "f"."distancegroup" AS "distancegroup", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "delayedflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 AND "f"."distancegroup" <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 120 AS "estimatedpassengersshorthaul", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 AND "f"."distancegroup" BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 150 AS "estimatedpassengersmediumhaul", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 AND "f"."distancegroup" >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 180 AS "estimatedpassengerslonghaul", (SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 AND "f"."distancegroup" <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 120 + SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 AND "f"."distancegroup" BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 150 + SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 AND "f"."distancegroup" >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 180) AS "totalestimatedaffectedpassengers", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "delayratepercentage" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE GROUP BY "f"."flightdate", "f"."distancegroup" ORDER BY "flightdate" DESC, "totalestimatedaffectedpassengers" DESC

SELECT "ft"."deptimeblk" AS "departuretimeblock", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "ft"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "delayeddepartures", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "ft"."depdel15" = 1 THEN "ft"."depdelay" END), 2) AS "avgdeparturedelay", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "ft"."depdel15" = 1 THEN "ft"."arrdelay" END), 2) AS "avgarrivaldelay", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "ft"."depdel15" = 1 THEN "ft"."depdelay" - "ft"."arrdelay" END), 2) AS "avgdelayrecoveryminutes", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "ft"."arrdelay" < "ft"."depdelay" AND "ft"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "ft"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "percentflightsrecoveredtime", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "ft"."arrdelay" < "ft"."depdelay" AND "ft"."depdel15" = 1 THEN "ft"."depdelay" - "ft"."arrdelay" END), 2) AS "avgminutesrecovered", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "ft"."arrdelay" >= "ft"."depdelay" AND "ft"."depdel15" = 1 THEN "ft"."depdelay" - "ft"."arrdelay" END), 2) AS "avgdelaygrowth" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "ft" WHERE NOT "ft"."arrdelay" IS NULL AND NOT "ft"."cancelled" AND NOT "ft"."depdelay" IS NULL AND NOT "ft"."deptimeblk" IS NULL AND NOT "ft"."diverted" GROUP BY "ft"."deptimeblk" ORDER BY SUBSTRING("ft"."deptimeblk", 1, 2) NULLS LAST

WITH "cancellationrates" AS (SELECT "flights"."operating_airline" AS "operating_airline", CASE WHEN "flights"."month" = 11 AND "flights"."dayofmonth" BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 'Thanksgiving' WHEN ("flights"."month" = 1 OR "flights"."month" = 12) AND ("flights"."dayofmonth" >= 20 OR "flights"."month" = 1) AND ("flights"."dayofmonth" <= 5 OR "flights"."month" = 12) AND ("flights"."dayofmonth" <= 5 OR "flights"."dayofmonth" >= 20) THEN 'Christmas_New_Year' ELSE 'Regular' END AS "periodtype", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."cancelled" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "cancellationrate" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" GROUP BY "flights"."operating_airline", CASE WHEN "flights"."month" = 11 AND "flights"."dayofmonth" BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 'Thanksgiving' WHEN ("flights"."month" = 1 OR "flights"."month" = 12) AND ("flights"."dayofmonth" >= 20 OR "flights"."month" = 1) AND ("flights"."dayofmonth" <= 5 OR "flights"."month" = 12) AND ("flights"."dayofmonth" <= 5 OR "flights"."dayofmonth" >= 20) THEN 'Christmas_New_Year' ELSE 'Regular' END HAVING COUNT(*) > 100) SELECT "cr"."operating_airline" AS "operating_airline", "cr"."periodtype" AS "periodtype", "cr"."cancellationrate" AS "holidaycancellationrate", "cancellationrates"."cancellationrate" AS "regularcancellationrate", "cr"."cancellationrate" - "cancellationrates"."cancellationrate" AS "ratedifference", ROUND(("cr"."cancellationrate" - "cancellationrates"."cancellationrate") * 100.0 / NULLIF("cancellationrates"."cancellationrate", 0), 2) AS "percentincrease" FROM "cancellationrates" AS "cr" JOIN "cancellationrates" AS "cancellationrates" ON "cancellationrates"."operating_airline" = "cr"."operating_airline" AND "cancellationrates"."periodtype" = 'Regular' WHERE "cr"."periodtype" IN ('Thanksgiving', 'Christmas_New_Year') ORDER BY "cr"."periodtype" NULLS LAST, "ratedifference" DESC

WITH "monthlydata" AS (SELECT "flights"."year" AS "year", "flights"."month" AS "month", COUNT(*) AS "airtrafficvolume", AVG("flights"."depdelayminutes") AS "avgdeparturedelay" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" WHERE ("flights"."cancelled" = FALSE OR "flights"."cancelled" IS NULL) AND ("flights"."month" <= EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) OR "flights"."month" > EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AND ("flights"."month" <= EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) OR "flights"."year" = 2018) AND ("flights"."month" > EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) OR "flights"."year" = 2019) AND ("flights"."year" = 2018 OR "flights"."year" = 2019) GROUP BY "flights"."year", "flights"."month"), "correlationcalc" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(*) * SUM("monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume" * "monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume") - SUM("monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume") * SUM("monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume")) * (COUNT(*) * SUM("monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay" * "monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay") - SUM("monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay") * SUM("monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay")) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (COUNT(*) * SUM("monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume" * "monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay") - SUM("monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume") * SUM("monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay")) / SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM("monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume" * "monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume") - SUM("monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume") * SUM("monthlydata"."airtrafficvolume")) * (COUNT(*) * SUM("monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay" * "monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay") - SUM("monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay") * SUM("monthlydata"."avgdeparturedelay"))) END AS "correlation" FROM "monthlydata" AS "monthlydata") SELECT "md"."year" AS "year", "md"."month" AS "month", "md"."airtrafficvolume" AS "airtrafficvolume", "md"."avgdeparturedelay" AS "avgdeparturedelay", "cc"."correlation" AS "delayvolumecorrelation" FROM "monthlydata" AS "md" CROSS JOIN "correlationcalc" AS "cc" ORDER BY "md"."year" NULLS LAST, "md"."month" NULLS LAST

WITH "routeclassification" AS (SELECT "flights"."origin" AS "origin", "flights"."dest" AS "dest", SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."dayofweek" <= 5 AND "flights"."dayofweek" >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "weekdayflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."dayofweek" <= 7 AND "flights"."dayofweek" >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "weekendflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."deptimeblk" IN ('0500-0559', '0600-0659', '0700-0759', '0800-0859', '0900-0959') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "morningflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."deptimeblk" IN ('1600-1659', '1700-1759', '1800-1859', '1900-1959') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "eveningflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."deptimeblk" IN ('1000-1059', '1100-1159', '1200-1259', '1300-1359', '1400-1459', '1500-1559') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "middayflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."deptimeblk" IN ('2000-2059', '2100-2159', '2200-2259', '2300-2359', '0001-0559', '0000-0059', '0100-0159', '0200-0259', '0300-0359', '0400-0459') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "midnightflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."origin" IN ('JFK', 'LAX', 'ORD', 'DFW', 'SFO', 'BOS', 'ATL', 'EWR', 'IAD', 'SEA') AND "flights"."dest" IN ('JFK', 'LAX', 'ORD', 'DFW', 'SFO', 'BOS', 'ATL', 'EWR', 'IAD', 'SEA') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "businesshubflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "flights"."dest" IN ('LAS', 'MCO', 'FLL', 'MIA', 'BWI', 'SAN', 'HNL', 'SLC', 'TPA') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "leisuredestinationflights" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "flights" GROUP BY "flights"."origin", "flights"."dest", "flights"."origincityname", "flights"."destcityname" HAVING COUNT(*) > 100), "delaypatterns" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ("routeclassification"."weekdayflights" * 1.0 / NULLIF("routeclassification"."weekendflights", 0) > 1.5 AND ("routeclassification"."morningflights" + "routeclassification"."eveningflights") * 1.0 / ("routeclassification"."morningflights" + "routeclassification"."eveningflights" + "routeclassification"."middayflights" + "routeclassification"."midnightflights") > 0.5 AND "routeclassification"."businesshubflights" > 0) THEN 'Business-Heavy' WHEN ("routeclassification"."weekendflights" * 1.0 / NULLIF("routeclassification"."weekdayflights", 0) > 0.7 AND "routeclassification"."middayflights" * 1.0 / ("routeclassification"."morningflights" + "routeclassification"."eveningflights" + "routeclassification"."middayflights" + "routeclassification"."midnightflights") > 0.4 AND "routeclassification"."leisuredestinationflights" > 0) THEN 'Leisure' ELSE 'Mixed' END AS "routetype", CASE WHEN "f"."dayofweek" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Weekday' ELSE 'Weekend' END AS "daytype", COUNT(*) AS "totalflights", SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "delayedflights", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "f"."depdel15" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "delayratepercent", ROUND(AVG("f"."depdelayminutes"), 2) AS "avgdelayminutes", ROUND(AVG("f"."taxiout"), 2) AS "avgtaxiout" FROM "flights"."public"."flights" AS "f" JOIN "routeclassification" AS "routeclassification" ON "f"."dest" = "routeclassification"."dest" AND "f"."origin" = "routeclassification"."origin" WHERE "f"."cancelled" = FALSE AND "f"."diverted" = FALSE GROUP BY CASE WHEN ("routeclassification"."weekdayflights" * 1.0 / NULLIF("routeclassification"."weekendflights", 0) > 1.5 AND ("routeclassification"."morningflights" + "routeclassification"."eveningflights") * 1.0 / ("routeclassification"."morningflights" + "routeclassification"."eveningflights" + "routeclassification"."middayflights" + "routeclassification"."midnightflights") > 0.5 AND "routeclassification"."businesshubflights" > 0) THEN 'Business-Heavy' WHEN ("routeclassification"."weekendflights" * 1.0 / NULLIF("routeclassification"."weekdayflights", 0) > 0.7 AND "routeclassification"."middayflights" * 1.0 / ("routeclassification"."morningflights" + "routeclassification"."eveningflights" + "routeclassification"."middayflights" + "routeclassification"."midnightflights") > 0.4 AND "routeclassification"."leisuredestinationflights" > 0) THEN 'Leisure' ELSE 'Mixed' END, CASE WHEN "f"."dayofweek" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Weekday' ELSE 'Weekend' END), "_u_0" AS (SELECT AVG("delaypatterns"."delayratepercent") AS "_col_0" FROM "delaypatterns" AS "delaypatterns") SELECT "delaypatterns"."routetype" AS "routetype", "delaypatterns"."daytype" AS "daytype", "delaypatterns"."totalflights" AS "totalflights", "delaypatterns"."delayedflights" AS "delayedflights", "delaypatterns"."delayratepercent" AS "delayratepercent", "delaypatterns"."avgdelayminutes" AS "avgdelayminutes", "delaypatterns"."avgtaxiout" AS "avgtaxiout", ROUND("delaypatterns"."delayratepercent" - "_u_0"."_col_0", 2) AS "delayratevsoverallavg" FROM "delaypatterns" AS "delaypatterns" CROSS JOIN "_u_0" AS "_u_0" ORDER BY "routetype" NULLS LAST, "daytype" NULLS LAST
